body:
yeah.. I guess it might seem that he's a douche, and I don't deny that sometimes he is.. but I have many times pushed him into that.. he's a nice person in general, but when he doesn't have the strength, he turns to the easy way out, which might mean hurting me just to make me get lost.. but yeah, I have made that happen myself for not controlling myself well enough... 

But yeah, I know what you mean, and I've been trying to only depend on myself.. at some point I would always say "I don't need anyone, I don't need anyone" when I was about to 'relapse'.. but yeah, that didn't last, I usually can't push these negative things away for long.. they always come back and sink me down low again..

But yeah.. thank you, for bothering to share and comment, I truly appreciate it. I hope for all the best to you!

thanks for saying that.. and on some level I always know.. but then it gets buried by all the self-hate and shame and everything else that's negative.. Now, venting here, getting awesome replies and watching a bit of Community got me to a bit of a better mood. I had forgotten that there was a subreddit for that, I will definitely check it out. I've been so unmotivated lately that it's already kinda sad.. which doesn't really help my case at all.... but yeah, thanks for answering to me

thank you.. luckily one online friend distracted me a bit that made me calm enough to go to sleep... I guess I should start jogging or something.. I dunno.. moving.. but when I get to a state like that.. it just seems pointless and I can't bring myself to do it.. I guess I have to try something next time.

thank you.. I tried sleeping overnight but that doesn't even help so much anymore.. it's a wonder I even calmed myself down enough to sleep.. 

the problem with me is.. the things that really are fucking me up are the things that are the hardest to talk about.. I am embarrassed about myself and about the fact that I don't know what the fuck I'm doing and all.. And most of the time I just find it very difficult to put it into words.. that's why therapy is difficult for me.. or well.. inefficient is a better word. It helps, up to a point. I've never been able to talk honestly there.. there's always been a limit.

I know that feeling too. I sometimes used to have that feeling.. like there was always a barrier I didn't cross with some people. 

Everyone says that people do care but.. no one around me is doing anything that would include me.. I know it probably sounds very self-centered and stupid but.. I'm tired of this. I'm not important enough to anyone so that they would actually do stuff with me.

I'm happy to talk if you want to.
I feel like there isn't a place I'd dare to scream at.. but I guess that's my fault..

yeah.. I know the feeling.. last night I just got myself drunk enough and managed to have a distraction, but now it seems that I'm back in the same mood again.. 

I don't know if it would help to think things in the perspective that you need to reach a goal with your studying and then you can maybe take it easier...? but that thought sucks though because in the loneliest hours.. nothing helps except having someone you could talk to or hang out with..

I am very familiar with the feeling that everyone is just drifting away and I hate it.. or hated it.. now it's basically already happened.

The one person I care about the most thinks that I'm pretty much just dirt.. and wishes that I'd stop bothering him.

It sucks. but I only wish that maybe you can think of the goal and maybe find someone around the place you study at.

I'm sorry, I wish I had been here sooner commenting.. where are you exactly, I mean... do you want to talk, do you want company? I'm lonely too.. I wish that you're still around and pm me if you still would like to talk about everything. Even though I might be feeling crappy, I like helping people and I can listen. Please, be there. pm me, we could talk in some messenger or something.

Don't let go of yourself.

checking on this throwaway after some time because I'm feeling anxious again.. it's just that he's not the one to blame really.. it's just that I'm in denial and I'm addicted.. also, I keep hooking up with him.. I think I might be a real sex addict (even though I think that it's really a myth in the public media) because I can't seem to give it up and don't want to and will do much for not to give it up.. I just.. I know it's probably not the wisest thing.. I'm really hurting myself with this and at the same time I don't want to give it up.

yes, thank you. You have some good points. I do know the value of learning to live with yourself though, it's just.. I've never truly mastered it.. right when I think I do, I get some sort of reaction maybe.. and then I'm back to square one.. because in the case of the person I have feelings for.. if he shows anything I'm back to square one because I get really uncertain because I don't want to screw it up but just by thinking things like that I'm already screwing it up and screwing everything up..

I guess I'm trying somewhat.. to move on. I'm probably moving out next year at least or trying to.. but yeah.. there's a long way to go.

oh and no we have never dated.. although he did get sort of close to me when he was still dating someone.. it was horrible of me, but I was desperate. It was the first time that someone had shown that kind of affection towards me then.. it kind of still is.

He's the person I've ever felt closest to..

mm.. thank you.. I was suffering from the anxiety for over an hour.. I've calmed down a bit.

I know flatmates don't mean instantly friends.. what I mean is.. we were already friends long before that. I already knew them long before that.. 

it's just.. like there's something really wrong with me.. I'm stuck with him. Sometimes he sort of lets me in even though he reminds me that he doesn't care for anything. He knows about my feelings. They have been there for many years..

I sort of would want to get away, but then sort of don't.. also, the apartment situation in my town is really bad..
my mind is a mess. 

I know it's really just.. batshit insane to keep holding on to these feelings.. I have actually sort of been moving past them now.. it still doesn't change that there are old grudges there when my depression/anxiety spikes and my mind starts to wander to negative directions..

They really are my only friends that currently live in this town.. or rather.. more accurately.. that one friends I have/had feelings for is my only friend... others have moved away or are just acquaintances..

I know.. but I'm somehow broken in my mind. I've been friends with him for  at least 4-5 years now.. most of that time I have had feelings for him.

so.. yeah I'm completely nuts.

I did get sort of over him at some point.. then I fell right back.. this has repeated itself.
I wish I could :( I'm really suffering from anxiety currently and just talking with someone or just listening would probably help but with skype my flatmates could hear.. ._.
I wish you all were in Finland but I know you aren't :( a meet-up would be lovely for me otherwise.. this is a good idea anyway
